Ever chased a taste so great, you crossed oceans? 🌍🍹 

As a half-English, half-Egyptian, my summers in Cairo were filled with great food and drinks! 

And i had one fizzy escape: V Super Soda. Natural flavors that hit different, a genius cap that lets you sip & seal on the go, and zero caffeine crashes, perfect for anytime hangouts. 

Cola lovers? This one’s bolder, crisper and more tasty than your usual suspects.

Couldn’t find anything like it in SG, so I setup MISRDELIGHTS and imported it myself!

Swipe through my love story (and why you NEED to try it).

VO RANGE CHALLENGE! .

#MyVisualVORange . 👩🏽🗣✨🗣🌀🗣 .

I came across this #VoiceActingChallenge in a tweet post by @hesham_voice_overs on instagram a while back and I thought it would be really interesting to apply a sense of reasoning! .

So I thought to myself: How do / can I really sound? What’s my #VORange? And its expansion? 🤔💭 .

I was very tempted to TRY to do impressions but the challenge instructs that we use only photos so here we go! .

Check it out!👇🏽 .

SLIDE 2: BUBBLES! Because I can get my #vocalRange to go up in a high pitch and TRY to sound like Bubbles (Power Puff Girls) or Dedee (Dexter’s Lab) . .

SLIDE 3: ME! Because I have my natural pitch! The one I’ve been blessed with! I’ve got my natural range so I sound like ME when I speak 🗣👩🏽 . .

SLIDE 4: DROOPY! Because I have tried to “playfully” make impressions pertaining to a lower range overtime and applied it skillfully to voice acting .

My voice naturally sounds deeper when I wake up each day so I kinda find it easy to play around low pitched sounds. I’m still working on it though but I’ve discovered that whenever I make a conscious effort to achieve a much deeper range, my throat burns like hell... DAMN! Oh well, but I guess it’ll all come together with practice! . .

Slide 5: GOLLUM!!! Because I can TRY to sound Gruff! Discovered this while exploring my #vocalRange! .

This is another range that can set your throat on fire! 😩🔥🤯 My Goodness! I wonder how Andrew Serkis (Original Voice Actor for Gollum) coped while #voiceacting for the whole movie! Lol! . .

That’s all Folks!!! So what’s your #VisualVORange? You’ll be amazed at what you come up with! Whether or not you choose to share is totally up to you! .

To all #VoiceActors! Roll out! 🗣🌀🗣🌀 . .
